# UniCompara

> > UniCompara helps students compare and choose among Italy's 11 MUR-recognized online universities (università telematiche), including eCampus, UniPegaso, UniNettuno, Mercatorum, and UniMarconi.

The platform provides comprehensive comparisons of online degree programs, costs, exam centers across Italian cities, and guides for transferring to distance learning universities. UniCompara covers bachelor's (L-18, L-33, L-07) and master's degrees (LM-23, LM-26, LM-63, LM-77) with focus on engineering, economics, and business management.

## Key Topics

- università telematiche (online universities)
- MUR recognition (Ministero dell'Università e della Ricerca)
- eCampus
- UniPegaso
- UniNettuno
- Mercatorum
- UniMarconi
- sedi esame (exam centers)
- costi università (university costs)
- laurea online (online degrees)
- ingegneria civile (civil engineering)
- confronto atenei (university comparisons)
- trasferimento crediti (credit transfer)
- sostenibilità (sustainability)
- digital marketing

## Essential Guides

- [Università Telematiche Riconosciute dal MUR: Elenco e Guida](https://unicompara.it/guida/riconoscimento-miur-universita-telematiche): Complete list of 11 MUR-recognized online universities in Italy
- [Trasferimento a un'Università Telematica: Come Fare](https://unicompara.it/guida/trasferimento-universita-telematica): Guide to transferring to online universities with credit recognition

## University Comparisons

- [UniNettuno vs UniDav | Confronto Completo](https://unicompara.it/confronto/uninettuno-vs-unidav): Compare UniNettuno vs UniDav: costs, courses, and exam centers

- [Costi Laurea Digital Marketing - Confronto](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/digital-marketing/costi): Compare costs of 5 Digital Marketing degrees: €1620-€3900/year

## Engineering Degrees

- [Ingegneria Civile (Architettura e ingegneria per la sostenibilità)](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/ingegneria-civile-architettura-e-ingegneria-per-la-sostenibilita-l-ambiente-e-le-infrastrutture): Civil Engineering Master's (LM-23) at Uninettuno - sustainability focus
- [Ingegneria della Sicurezza (Sicurezza delle Strutture Civili e Industriali)](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/ingegneria-della-sicurezza-sicurezza-delle-strutture-civili-e-industriali): Safety Engineering Master's (LM-26) at UniPegaso - structural security
- [Ingegneria Civile e Ambientale LM-23 eCampus](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/ingegneria-civile-lm-23-ecampus): Civil & Environmental Engineering Master's (LM-23) at eCampus
- [Ingegneria Gestionale LM-33 - Produttività Unimarconi](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/ingegneria-industriale-lm-33-unimarconi-3): Industrial Management Engineering (LM-33) at Unimarconi - production
- [Ingegneria delle Infrastrutture per una Mobilità Sostenibile](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/ingegneria-delle-infrastrutture-per-una-mobilita-sostenibile-mobilita): Sustainable Mobility Infrastructure Engineering (L-07) at Mercatorum

## Business & Economics Degrees

- [Economia e Business Management L-18 | Uninettuno](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/economia-l-18-uninettuno): Business Economics & Management (L-18) Bachelor's at Uninettuno
- [Psicoeconomia L-33: Nuovi Corsi eCampus](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/economia-l-33-ecampus-2): Psychoeconomics L-33 degree at eCampus - behavioral economics online
- [Gestione d'impresa (Green Economy e Gestione Sostenibile)](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/gestione-d-impresa-e-tecnologie-digitali-green-economy-e-gestione-sostenibile): Business Management Master's (LM-77) at Uninettuno - green economy focus
- [Gestione del rischio e Compliance Normativa - Unitelma](https://unicompara.it/corsi-di-laurea/gestione-del-rischio-e-compliance-normativa): Risk Management & Compliance Master's (LM-63) at Unitelma online
